findings.issue: Model sentence stacks two causal で clauses with near-synonymous words (心配 / 不安), which is redundant and unnatural as a teaching example; one cause clause suffices.
findings.current: 明日の試験が心配で、不安で眠れなかった
findings.suggested: 明日の試験が不安で眠れなかった

findings.issue: The showcase example for 不安 stacks two near-synonymous causal clauses (心配で + 不安で), which is redundant and unnatural for a beginner model sentence; a native editor would keep only one.
findings.current: 明日の試験が心配で、不安で眠れなかった
findings.suggested: 明日の試験が不安で眠れなかった

findings.issue: The description says the word group has 'leitura fu', but the cited examples 武器 (ぶき) and 無事 (ぶじ) are read with bu, not fu — the claim is inaccurate as written.
findings.current: um grupo de palavras N3 com leitura fu, de ansiedade e infelicidade a casal, arma e paisagem
findings.suggested: um grupo de palavras N3 com leitura fu/bu, de ansiedade e infelicidade a casal, arma e paisagem
